name: Miyuki
source:
A long time ago, there was a tale of the daughter of a Yuki-Onna, who fascinated the men in the village and did awful things. Lately she had escaped from the place where she was trapped,  by taking advantage of [url=/c106114]the protagonist[/url], who knew almost nothing about her. Once out Miyuki starts exacting vengeance upon the villagers who had previously imprisoned her. Contrary to her beauty, she is willing to stain herself with their blood. No one knows what Miyuki is really thinking, as she wears the same sneer on her face at all times. Can the protagonist possibly stop her? 

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010625112432fw_/http://www.din.or.jp/~syscom/ange/new/eternity/index.html]official website[/url].]
